ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organisms compete for the mouse as a food source?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the diagram is a food web, labeled wildflowers, grass, rabbit, mouse, snake, hawk. The arrows indicate by which predator the food is eaten. Near mouse, it can be seen that there is an arrow from mouse to snake, and there is also an arrow from mouse to hawk. Then reason: the question asks which organisms compete to use mouse as a food source. Because snake and hawk both feed on mouse, they compete for the same food source, mouse.
